summary: End-to-end test of the new Leave & Permission Module (Indonesian Payroll). Backend pytest suite (20 tests) and Playwright UI flows (admin + employee portal) all PASS. No critical issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2555 lines — consider splitting feature modules (leave, portal, payroll, THR, auth) into routers under /app/backend/routers/ for maintainability.
Attachment stored as base64 inside MongoDB document works for <2MB but doubles storage; for future scale move to GridFS or external blob storage.
Email notification uses asyncio.create_task without awaiting — fire-and-forget is fine but errors are only logged inside the coroutine; consider a small retry/queue mechanism.

LeaveReviewIn.hr_note defaults to '' but is Optional — slight inconsistency; either make it required str with min_length=1 for /reject endpoint or keep current behavior with explicit 400 check (current code does the latter, which is correct).
Reject modal allows submitting empty note and shows toast; UI could disable the confirm button until textarea has non-whitespace input (minor UX).

Backend endpoints: POST/GET/DELETE /api/portal/leave, GET /api/portal/leave/{id}/attachment, GET/PUT /api/leave (+/stats,/{id},/{id}/approve,/{id}/reject,/{id}/attachment). Frontend pages: /portal/leave and /leave with nav badge polling /api/leave/stats. All data-testid identifiers as documented in the review request are present and working. Existing flows (employees list, portal payslips) regression-tested OK.
